to_s.description: target replay time; earlier than now resets + replays
to_s.title: To S

changed.description: set by the runtime vs the previous decision
changed.title: Changed

explanation.description: optional LLM wording of the facts
explanation.title: Explanation

clip_end_s.description: end within the segment clip, seconds
clip_end_s.title: Clip End S

clip_start_s.description: start within the segment clip, seconds
clip_start_s.title: Clip Start S

media_ref.description: app-controlled media path, e.g. /api/archive/media?source=… (never a JWT URL)
media_ref.title: Media Ref

object_counts.description: YOLO11 object counts for this clip, if available
object_counts.title: Object Counts

ride_offset_s.description: seconds from the start of the recorded ride
ride_offset_s.title: Ride Offset S

segment_id.description: VSS source segment id (the `source` of the clip)
segment_id.title: Segment Id

persistence_weight.description: 2 ** (-age_s / half_life_s) at snapshot time; heuristic weight
persistence_weight.title: Persistence Weight

expected_delay_s.description: assumed delay if the rider meets it (demonstration assumption)
expected_delay_s.title: Expected Delay S

LineString.description: GeoJSON LineString. coordinates are [lon, lat] pairs.
LineString.title: LineString

session_time_s.description: replay time at which this becomes available
session_time_s.title: Session Time S

source_group_id.description: one sighting: adjacent chunks / repeated frames share this id, so they are never counted as independent observers
source_group_id.title: Source Group Id

PersistencePrior.description: Type-based persistence assumption. A heuristic, not a validated probability.
PersistencePrior.title: PersistencePrior

next_step_index.description: index into the active route's steps of the next maneuver
next_step_index.title: Next Step Index

label.default: bicycle route from provider, subject to map restrictions
label.title: Label

steps.description: provider turn-by-turn steps; empty for fixtures
steps.title: Steps

RouteStep.description: One provider turn instruction. Indices point into `RouteCandidate.geometry.coordinates`.
RouteStep.title: RouteStep

SessionEvent.description: Local activity log line. NOT a Weave trace.
SessionEvent.title: SessionEvent

labels.description: simulation / provenance labels to always show
labels.title: Labels

revision.description: monotonic; increases on every state change
revision.title: Revision

Verification.description: Result of re-checking a clip (Cosmos Reason). Model checking is not ground truth.
Verification.title: Verification
